description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LogicHookTest' that tests the 'LogicHook' class and related functionality within the SuiteCRM codebase. It verifies methods such as initialization, hook loading, hook processing, and hook directory scanning, specifically for the module 'Accounts' and default hooks.
